scope: Agent visual/scenario review of stage window chrome; not a human usability study or final M12 accessibility qualification
findings: Native Inter captions and original icons remain legible; active/inactive borders differ; white Close ink contrasts on red.
Caption labels and controls have separate hover/press/focus states, with shared geometry.
Unsaved work and owner-only modal controls remain explicit, including keyboard commands.

carry_forward.observation: Existing shared-menu helper footer uses bounded ellipsis; complete fitting remains planned.
Raw HiDPI captures suggest drawn cursor displacement. Isolate capture timing versus native cursor coordinates; scripted actions alone do not establish pointer usability.
